name: Chicken with Prosciutto, Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto, Zucchini & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Place oven racks in the upper, middle, and lower positions.
Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; spread the top side with pesto, then wrap with prosciutto. Transfer to a large baking dish and drizzle with oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1 cup sun-dried tomato pesto
15 slices prosciutto
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish on the upper rack of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until prosciutto is golden brown and chicken is cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons. Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Add mushrooms to the baking sheets with the zucchini. Drizzle veggies with additional oil and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (227g ) pkg sliced white mushrooms
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets on the middle and lower racks of the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates. Enjoy!
